entries.name: ctl-true#0
entries.script: [ctl-true] `Coll(⟨EF BF BD⟩) == Coll(⟨EF BF BD⟩)`, both written `EF BF BD` → true at cost 41. CONTROL: well-formed text on both sides.

entries.name: ctl-false#1
entries.script: [ctl-false] `Coll("A") == Coll("B")` → false at cost 41. CONTROL: equal lengths, unequal text: the comparison is charged and answers false.

entries.name: sur-vs-1repl#2
entries.script: [sur-vs-1repl] `Coll(⟨ED A0 80⟩) == Coll(⟨EF BF BD⟩)` → true at cost 41. SEPARATING: the JDK takes ANY continuation byte after `ED`, so an encoded surrogate is ONE U+FFFD; a decoder that replaces it per maximal subpart (three U+FFFD), or that keeps the bytes, answers the other way.

entries.name: sur-vs-3repl#3
entries.script: [sur-vs-3repl] `Coll(⟨ED A0 80⟩) == Coll(⟨EF BF BD × 3⟩)` → false at cost 24. The lengths differ (1 against 3 UTF-16 units), so no character comparison is charged. SEPARATING: the JDK takes ANY continuation byte after `ED`, so an encoded surrogate is ONE U+FFFD; a decoder that replaces it per maximal subpart (three U+FFFD), or that keeps the bytes, answers the other way.

entries.name: sur-same#4
entries.script: [sur-same] `Coll(⟨ED A0 80⟩) == Coll(⟨ED A0 80⟩)` → true at cost 41. CONTROL: the same bytes on both sides are equal under any decoder.

entries.name: sur40-same#5
entries.script: [sur40-same] `Coll(40 × ⟨ED A0 80⟩) == Coll(40 × ⟨ED A0 80⟩)`, 120 bytes a side → true at cost 41. Decoded, each side is 40 UTF-16 units: one 96-unit chunk of the String comparison, the cost of a one-character string. SEPARATING on cost: a port that counts the 120 bytes, or 120 replacement characters, charges two chunks (43, as ctl-repl120-same).

entries.name: ctl-repl40-same#6
entries.script: [ctl-repl40-same] `Coll(40 × ⟨EF BF BD⟩) == Coll(40 × ⟨EF BF BD⟩)`, 120 bytes of `EF BF BD` a side → true at cost 41. CONTROL for sur40-same: well-formed, 40 UTF-16 units, the same cost.

entries.name: ctl-repl120-same#7
entries.script: [ctl-repl120-same] `Coll(120 × ⟨EF BF BD⟩) == Coll(120 × ⟨EF BF BD⟩)` → true at cost 43. CONTROL: what 120 UTF-16 units cost, two chunks.

entries.name: overlong3-vs-3repl#8
entries.script: [overlong3-vs-3repl] `Coll(⟨E0 80 80⟩) == Coll(⟨EF BF BD × 3⟩)` → true at cost 41. An overlong form (`E0 80..9F`) becomes one U+FFFD PER BYTE. SEPARATING: a decoder that replaces the overlong sequence once answers false.

entries.name: overlong3-vs-1repl#9
entries.script: [overlong3-vs-1repl] `Coll(⟨E0 80 80⟩) == Coll(⟨EF BF BD⟩)` → false at cost 24. The lengths differ (3 against 1). SEPARATING: a decoder that replaces the overlong sequence once answers true.

entries.name: neq-sur-vs-1repl#10
entries.script: [neq-sur-vs-1repl] `Coll(⟨ED A0 80⟩) != Coll(⟨EF BF BD⟩)` → false at cost 41. `NEQ` calls the same comparer. SEPARATING, as sur-vs-1repl.

entries.name: pair-sur-vs-1repl#11
entries.script: [pair-sur-vs-1repl] `(⟨ED A0 80⟩, 1) == (⟨EF BF BD⟩, 1)`, two `(String, Int)` constants → true at cost 35. The same decoding inside a pair. SEPARATING, as sur-vs-1repl.

entries.name: pair-sur-vs-3repl#12
entries.script: [pair-sur-vs-3repl] `(⟨ED A0 80⟩, 1) == (⟨EF BF BD × 3⟩, 1)` → false at cost 15. The lengths differ; the String case bails before charging the comparison. SEPARATING, as sur-vs-3repl.

entries.name: pair-ctl#13
entries.script: [pair-ctl] `(⟨EF BF BD⟩, 1) == (⟨EF BF BD⟩, 1)` → true at cost 35. CONTROL for the pair rows.

entries.name: subst-sur-vs-1repl#14
entries.script: [subst-sur-vs-1repl] `substConstants(tree with String constant ⟨ED A0 80⟩, Coll[Int](), Coll[Int]()) == the same tree with `EF BF BD`` → true at cost 238. `substConstants` re-writes the tree, and the constant goes out as decoded text. SEPARATING: a port that keeps the bytes returns the input.

entries.name: subst-sur-vs-3repl#15
entries.script: [subst-sur-vs-3repl] `substConstants(tree with String constant ⟨ED A0 80⟩, …) == the tree with `EF BF BD × 3`` → false at cost 221. SEPARATING, as sur-vs-3repl.

entries.name: subst-ctl-repl#16
entries.script: [subst-ctl-repl] `substConstants(tree with String constant ⟨EF BF BD⟩, …) == the same tree` → true at cost 238. CONTROL for the substConstants rows.
